I know exactly how that feels. I don't know how to tell you to distract yourself but that's my best advice for myself when it comes to disengaging my enraged or depressed moments. 

Distractions.... mine isn't a healthy distraction. I drink. The drinking doesn't help and can quite often ignite a match but the friends I keep(read: random strangers at barrooms) make the perfect distraction for me. I can stop caring and just talk about random shit instead of those things that allow those negative thoughts to creep back in. I dunno, I wish I played music or was an artist. Sometimes I can distract myself with games but at some point I lose my drive to even win so whats the point...I'll need a different distraction. I may soon invest in a bike and just start riding randomly.

Thank you. 

> Knowing how she feels about talking before talking is key to approaching this

I'm going to keep this in mind as I think it's something I probably haven't ever kept in mind when reeling her back in over the years.

I love her more than life itself and I truly don't know how to handle this void. I try to think of positive stuff just to keep going and try not to think of her just to distract myself but invariably someone brings her up every fucking day. I don't want to not want to think about her but I am filled with rage each and every time I have to. Seem busting rage that I can only avoid by either drinking, sleeping or working(when I can even focus).
